purpose: Reference values for the rule-based training recommendation layer. Ranges, costs and inventories are public-report approximations or stated assumptions from the local scenario documents; none is a measured or certified performance figure, and no engagement or damage model uses them.

notes.en: Speed disadvantage against jet-type targets; preserve against decoy-leaning groups.
notes.ko: 제트형 표적에는 속도 열세. 미끼 성향 집단에는 보존.

cost_note.en: Low marginal cost; one target at a time, 8-11 s per engagement (assumption)
cost_note.ko: 발당 비용 낮음, 한 번에 한 표적, 표적당 8~11초(가정)

notes.en: Preferred for jet-type and fiber-optic FPV targets.

cost_note.en: Ammunition cost low; debris footprint restricts use over facilities
cost_note.ko: 탄약 비용 낮음, 잔해 낙하 구역 때문에 시설 상공 제한

notes.en: Rejected when debris would fall inside the fence or on the runway.
notes.ko: 잔해가 울타리 안쪽이나 활주로에 떨어지면 거부.

cost_note.en: Reusable; interferes with own radar and has no effect on fiber-optic or autonomous aircraft
cost_note.ko: 재사용 가능, 아군 레이더 간섭, 광섬유·자율 비행체에는 무효

notes.en: Rejected near own radar; penalized without RF emission evidence.
notes.ko: 아군 레이더 근처 거부, RF 발신 근거 없으면 감점.

unit_kinds.reference: data/sensors/radar_reference_specs.json (instrumented range mode, not detection range)

sector_prior.note: Scenario prior only: approaches are biased to the north in the planning documents; weights are not derived from real geography.
